description:
lib.rs:209 — Error::source() has two match arms with identical bodies (both return Some(e)):

    Error::CrlParseError(e) => Some(e),
    Error::OcspParseError(e) => Some(e),

clippy::match_same_arms (pedantic) flags this. Fix: merge with an or-pattern:

    Error::CrlParseError(e) | Error::OcspParseError(e) => Some(e),

Strictly readability/idiomatic — no functional change.
title: [rusty/pkix-revocation] merge identical match arms in Error::source()
